name: tide-load-harness
description: Load-test harness for the Tide network. Imports @tideorg/js to drive real protocol traffic from a Node server callable by Locust.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/server.ts src/warmup/index.ts src/loadtest/index.ts src/protocol/cli.ts src/protocol/loadtest.ts src/admin/provision.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --external:playwright --external:express --external:undici --external:tough-cookie --external:@types/* --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
